rows.evidence: Working title chosen by the builder; the creator can rename it.
First playable release of the agreed free-roam scope.
Creator picked Miles Morales on Melty's Create page; search_games returned this installed-host slug.
Creator, 2026-10-12: "free roam first". Each player sees the other's Miles in the open city.
Derived from the agreed free-roam scope: host presses Play, friend joins through Melty, both load a save and meet in the city.
Agreed scope: each player keeps their own game and save; enemies and missions are not shared in this version.
Each player's equipped suit parts are sent to the other game and applied to their double.
Creator's original goal, kept as the roadmap; not part of this version.
Creator accepted MIT with remixes allowed.
Creator requires keeping the chosen host and its window arrangement; the mod never changes display settings.
This version reads the player's pose and suit only; it writes no save or config of the game.
The game imports winmm.dll directly and Windows searches the game's folder first for it. A version.dll proxy was tried first and never loaded: the game process took Windows' own copy.

Seen in testing: the other player's web lines and effects are not drawn; enemies and missions are per player; a second copy of the game on the same PC cannot get past its own main menu (true without the mod too), so two-player play needs two PCs.
